ratingReasons.gameplay: A coherent recover-three-memories then disable-coils mission, with sprint, regenerating shield, ADS and phase adding choices. Both attempts reached the boss. Multi-direction pressure and rapid losses while trying to identify and shoot targets made combat less legible than traversal. My poor aim and standing exposed contributed materially to both deaths.
ratingReasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber palette, rainy wet ground reflections, composed title/end screens and a distinctive giant relay landmark. Geometry, props and robots remain visibly simple and repeated; the yard feels sparse for an AAA comparison.
ratingReasons.usability: Visible handbook, key strip, map that pauses, objective distances, receiver proximity guidance, replenishment and clear deploy-again flow worked. Getting within the receiver floor ring required repeated adjustments; the handbook is dense for learning under combat pressure.
ratingReasons.readability: Large health/ammo and clear objective markers help. Small spaced text, several simultaneous corner/center messages, many directional threat chevrons and small copper target areas against the facility make rapid combat interpretation demanding. Coil OFF confirmation was useful.
ratingReasons.aaaReadiness: This functions as a cohesive playable slice with strong art direction, but the observed asset simplicity, repetition, sparse space and combat-information density fall well below an AAA-ready presentation and polish standard. This is not a performance or audio certification.
ratingReasons.replayability: The second attempt benefited from learning routes and exposed-versus-covered decisions. One observed mission and repeated objective structure limit evidence of longer-term variety. This is an analytical judgment, not a claim about human enjoyment.

outcomes.progress: Reached Custodian, approached to 11 m, died during the first sustained coil firing attempt. No disabled coil confirmed before death.
Reached Custodian at range; visible status confirmed coil 3 OFF while coils 1 and 2 were 100%. Died during further firing. Extraction not reached.

observedStrengths: Map identifies archives, player, cover, boss and extraction, and pauses planning.
Recovery updates individual memory slots, named memory cards and supplies.
Boss physical numbered plates match visible numbered status, including OFF.
Distinctive lighting, rain and relay landmark establish atmosphere.
observedProblems: Repeated movement adjustments needed to enter memory recovery reach despite a nearby marker.
Enemies and copper targets are relatively small; prop occlusion frequently complicates a firing solution.
Multiple attack directions and layered instructions can overload the small-text HUD during combat.
Simple repeated geometry and robot forms leave substantial visual polish work for AAA readiness.
Requested build number differs from the title screen's BUILD 45 label.

method.interaction: Only visible game UI, driver help, handbook, map and screenshots. Exactly two terminal ordinary mission attempts, with visible DEPLOY AGAIN between them. No third attempt or rescore.
method.evidence: Driver preserved every action, screenshot and response in docs/media/build47-review2. No page errors were reported in observed responses.
limits: Software-WebGL fallback; not a GPU or hardware performance benchmark.
Discrete relative-look and timed inputs with pauses for screenshots do not replicate continuous human play or reaction timing.
No supported audio assessment or human-enjoyment conclusion.
No extraction experience because both attempts ended in death.
No source, assets, tests, previous reports, hidden state, arbitrary evaluation or external route guidance inspected.
